canonical_definition:
What it is. In the available definition, TOEFL11 is treated as the ETS Corpus of Non-Native Written English, and it is described as a benchmark dataset used for Native Language Identification research. The source snippet also places it among two benchmark datasets for NLI experiments, alongside Write & Improve Corpus 2024.

What it is claimed to measure. The recorded measurement claim is narrow: TOEFL11 is linked to one behavioral indicator and no constructs. Specifically, Native language identification is measured by TOEFL11, so the instrument is reported as evaluating native language identification rather than a broader spread of targets.

Space of uses. One paper uses TOEFL11 together with Write & Improve Corpus 2024 in experiments, positioning it as one of two benchmark datasets for NLI.
